item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q015_artifact_tag_not_homology","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, d1a14h2 is not a second natural antibody domain. It is the 8-residue N-terminal synthetic tag on PDB 1a14 chain H: SCOPe domain d1a14h2, SUNID 343393, description \"1a14 H:1-8\", classified in class l Artifacts, fold l.1 Tags, superfamily l.1.1 Tags, family l.1.1.1 Tags, under N-terminal Tags / Synthetic. Similarity to d1a14h2, or to the l.1.1.1 tag family, should therefore be treated as tag/artifact evidence only; the SCOPe homology section explicitly does not imply homology for this domain and warns that class l contains artificial sequence artifacts whose similarity does not imply biological homology. By contrast, the adjacent d1a14h1 segment, residues 9-111 of chain H, is the real immunoglobulin heavy-chain variable domain in b.1.1.1, so classification, homology, functional transfer, template choice, or representative-domain selection should not transfer from the tiny N-terminal tag to the antibody V-set domain or to a query protein matching only the tag.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_service_info","/api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope.get_scop_pdb_entry","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1a14","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1a14/chains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1a14/domains","mcp__scope.get_scop_domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h1/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h2/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a14h2/homology"]}]}
